title: Sandbox and Bedrock Tools
summary: This module provides tools for interacting with AWS Bedrock services, including agents, browser, code interpreter, and knowledge bases. It also offers integrations with external sandbox environments like Daytona and E2B for executing code and commands.

nodes.label: Invoke Bedrock Agent
nodes.title: Bedrock Agent Invocation Tool
nodes.description: A tool to invoke an AWS Bedrock agent, allowing it to process queries and return completions. It handles session management and optional tracing for agent interactions.

nodes.label: Create Bedrock Browser Toolkit
nodes.title: Bedrock Browser Toolkit Creator
nodes.description: A function that initializes and returns a toolkit designed for browser-based interactions within the AWS Bedrock environment, enabling agents to perform web browsing tasks.

nodes.label: Create Bedrock Code Interpreter Toolkit
nodes.title: Bedrock Code Interpreter Toolkit Creator
nodes.description: A function that initializes and returns a toolkit for executing code within an AWS Bedrock code interpreter environment, facilitating computational tasks for agents.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Bedrock Knowledge Base
nodes.title: Bedrock Knowledge Base Retriever
nodes.description: A tool designed to retrieve relevant information from an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base based on a given query, supporting various retrieval configurations and guardrail settings.

nodes.label: Manage Daytona Sandbox
nodes.title: Daytona Sandbox Base Manager
nodes.description: The foundational tool for managing the lifecycle of Daytona sandboxes, including their creation, deletion, and configuration for persistent or ephemeral use across tool calls.

nodes.label: Manage E2B Sandbox
nodes.title: E2B Sandbox Base Manager
nodes.description: The foundational tool for managing the lifecycle of E2B sandboxes, including their creation, termination, and configuration for persistent or ephemeral use across tool calls.

nodes.label: Execute E2B Sandbox Command
nodes.title: E2B Sandbox Command Executor
nodes.description: A specialized tool that executes shell commands within an E2B sandbox environment, providing the command's exit code, standard output, and standard error.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Agents Service
nodes.title: AWS Bedrock Agents
nodes.description: The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Bedrock service responsible for hosting and orchestrating AI agents, providing access to various foundation models and tools.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base Service
nodes.title: AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base
nodes.description: The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Bedrock service that manages and provides access to knowledge bases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows.

nodes.label: Daytona Sandbox Environment
nodes.title: Daytona Sandbox
nodes.description: An external cloud-based development environment provided by Daytona, used for secure and isolated execution of code and commands.

nodes.label: E2B Sandbox Environment
nodes.title: E2B Sandbox
nodes.description: An external cloud-based development environment provided by E2B, offering isolated execution for code, scripts, and shell commands.

groups.label: AWS Bedrock Integrations
groups.title: AWS Bedrock Integrations
groups.description: Components facilitating interaction with various AWS Bedrock services, including agents, browser, code interpreter, and knowledge bases.

groups.label: External Sandbox Tools
groups.title: External Sandbox Tools
groups.description: Tools for managing and interacting with external sandbox environments like Daytona and E2B for isolated code execution.
